infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Work kms uses your location to measure the distance of work trips you start.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Work kms keeps measuring a work trip you started while your phone is locked or you're using other apps. It stops as soon as you finish the trip.
